integrity: Proof reconstructs coefficient positivity, standard q-gamma asymptotics, entire-series domination, an independent OU first-passage integral and equicoercivity of minimizers; accompanying checker.py passed 33 numerical assertions. Numerical diagnostics are not certificates of infinite-domain theorems.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite-a MFPT series is prior work; this finding establishes global unique optimality and weak-contraction optimizer/optimal-time limits only in one-dimensional drift-free Poisson positive partial resetting. No quantitative convergence rate or general reset-law extension; numerical constants are approximations. Independent validation not performed.
title: Unique optimal search and the weak-contraction Ornstein–Uhlenbeck limit under partial resetting
